# Communal Platform API

API documentation for the Communal platform. This document describes version 2026-08-25.

Optionally send the `X-Api-Version` (or `Api-Version`) header with a supported date version. When omitted, the server uses the default version (2026-08-25). Supported versions: 2026-02-01, 2026-03-25, 2026-08-25.

Version-specific docs: `/docs/api/{version}` (e.g. `/docs/api/2026-03-25`).

Version: 2026-08-25

## Servers

- **Prod**: https://api.getcommunal.com/api

## Authentication

- **http**: http (bearer)

## Endpoints

### Activity

#### GET /activities/card-deliveries

List all digital member card delivery activities

**Parameters:**

- `filter[member_id]` (query) - Filter activities by the member ID belonging to the related user. Accepts alphanumeric strings.
- `filter[request_hash]` (query) - Filter activities by the unique request hash for tracing API requests.
- `filter[date_from]` (query) - Return activities created on or after the provided date. Format: ISO 8601 date/datetime (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).
- `filter[date_to]` (query) - Return activities created on or before the provided date. Format: ISO 8601 date/datetime (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).
- `filter[status]` (query) - Filter activities by delivery status. Supported values: `success`, `failed`.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: 
- `401`: 
- `403`:

#### GET /attendance_records

List attendance records

**Parameters:**

- `filter[attendance_sheet_id]` (query) - Filter by attendance sheet ID.
- `filter[query]` (query) - Filter by attendee name.
- `filter[export]` (query) - When true, request a CSV export.
- `filter[export_email]` (query) - Email to receive export notification/download link.
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: attendanceSheet, programSignup, programSignup.program.
- `sort` (query) - Sort by attendee name. Prefix with - for descending. Option: participant_name.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `AttendanceRecordResource`
- `401`:

### Booking

#### GET /bookings

List bookings
Paginated facility bookings for the current organization. Members see
their own bookings; managers see all bookings. Nested write, export, and
search routes on this controller stay undocumented.

**Parameters:**

- `filter[user_id]` (query) - Filter by owning user id. Members are limited to their own bookings regardless of this value.
- `filter[bookable_entity]` (query) - Filter by facility (bookable entity) id(s), including child facilities of a parent. Comma-separated for multiple.
- `filter[id]` (query) - Filter by exact booking id(s), comma-separated.
- `filter[recurring_id]` (query) - Filter by the recurring series id.
- `filter[uuid]` (query) - Filter by exact booking uuid.
- `filter[starting_at]` (query) - Filter to bookings that start on or after this date/time.
- `filter[ending_at]` (query) - Filter to bookings that end on or before this date/time.
- `filter[query]` (query) - Search bookings by owner name or email, facility name, or booking id.
- `filter[associated_booking_id]` (query) - Filter by the parent booking id for linked/child bookings. Pass an empty value to match bookings with no parent.
- `filter[only_recurring]` (query) - When true, only bookings that belong to a recurring series.
- `filter[tags]` (query) - Filter by tag name(s), comma-separated.
- `filter[with_product]` (query) - Filter to bookings associated with the given product id.
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: user, guest, bookableEntity, bookableEntity.parent, associatedBooking, organization, bookingItems, tags, formSubmissions, recurringBooking, facilities, bookingContactDetails, products.
- `append` (query) - Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options include readable_start_time, readable_end_time, owner_name, owner_email, owner_telephone, invoices_paid, total_amount_of_invoices, participants.
- `sort` (query) - Sort field. Options: id, starting_at, ending_at. Prefix with - for descending.
- `page[number]` (query) - Page number for pagination.
- `page[size]` (query) - Number of results per page.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: 
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `422`: 
- `500`: 

#### GET /bookings/{booking}

Get a booking
Returns a single facility booking, scoped to the current tenant.

**Parameters:**

- `booking` (path) (required)
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: bookableEntity, bookableEntity.parent, bookableEntity.parent.form, bookableEntity.form, notes, organization, tags, user, guest, formSubmissions, facilities, bookingItems, bookingContactDetails, recurringBooking, products, invoices.transactions.
- `append` (query) - Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options include combined_notes, owner_name, owner_email, owner_telephone, participants, facilities_with_cost, created_by.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: 
- `401`: 
- `403`: 

### Booking Request

#### GET /booking_requests

List booking requests
Paginated booking requests for the current tenant. Members see their own
requests; facility managers and super admins see the full list. The
default row is a curated payload (schedule, cost, owner, facility, state).
Pass `include` / `append` to add related records.

**Parameters:**

- `filter[query]` (query) - Search by owner name, facility name, or organization name.
- `filter[bookable_entity_id]` (query) - Filter by bookable entity id(s). Also matches child facilities of a parent entity. Comma-separated.
- `filter[booking_state_id]` (query) - Filter by booking state id(s). Comma-separated. Include the declined sentinel to also return declined requests.
- `filter[user_id]` (query) - Filter by owning member id. Non-managers may only use their own id.
- `filter[starting_at]` (query) - Filter to requests that start on or after this datetime.
- `filter[ending_at]` (query) - Filter to requests that end on or before this datetime.
- `filter[uuid]` (query) - Look up a single request by its public uuid.
- `filter[recurring_id]` (query) - Filter to requests in a recurring series.
- `filter[tags]` (query) - Filter by tag name(s). Comma-separated.
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: bookableEntity, bookableEntity.parent, bookableEntity.form, guest, user, bookingState, transaction, organization, bookingItems, tags, bookingContactDetails, recurringBooking, formSubmissions, files, notes, facilities.
- `append` (query) - Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options: owner_name, owner_email, owner_telephone, invoices_paid, total_amount_of_invoices, combined_notes, associated_recurring_ids, flat_total_for_user_and_availability, next_state, previous_state, participant_name (facility managers and super admins only).
- `sort` (query) - Sort by id, starting_at, or ending_at. Prefix with - for descending.
- `page[number]` (query) - Page number for pagination.
- `page[size]` (query) - Number of results per page.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `BookingRequestResource`
- `401`: 

#### GET /booking_requests/{booking_request}

Get a booking request
Returns a single booking request. Members may only view their own;
facility managers and super admins may view any request in the tenant.

**Parameters:**

- `booking_request` (path) (required)
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: bookableEntity, bookableEntity.parent, bookableEntity.form, guest, user, bookingState, transaction, files, notes, organization, recurringBooking, tags, formSubmissions, formSubmissions.form, bookingContactDetails, bookingItems, facilities.
- `append` (query) - Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options: remaining_recurring_bookings, combined_notes, owner_name, owner_email, owner_telephone, created_by, facilities_with_cost, next_state, previous_state, buffer_minutes, participant_name (facility managers and super admins only).
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: `BookingRequestResource`
- `401`: 
- `404`:

### Custom Profile Field Value

#### GET /custom_profile_field_values

List custom profile field values
Returns a paginated list of stored custom profile field values. Filter by
`user_id`, `family_id`, or `custom_profile_field_id`, and use
`?include=customProfileField` to embed the parent field.

**Parameters:**

- `filter[user_id]` (query)
- `filter[family_id]` (query)
- `filter[custom_profile_field_id]` (query)
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `CustomProfileFieldValueResource`
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `422`: 

#### POST /custom_profile_field_values

Create custom profile field value
Stores a value for a custom profile field. POST requires exactly one of
`user_id` or `family_id`. Empty values are ignored, and values cannot be
modified from a parent tenant.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Request Body:**

Content-Type: `application/json`

**Responses:**

- `200`: `CustomProfileFieldValueResource`
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `422`: 

#### PUT /custom_profile_field_values/{id}

Update custom profile field value
Updates a stored custom profile field value by id. Submitting an empty

### Facility

#### GET /facilities

List facilities
Returns a paginated list of the spaces and resources members can book,
with their booking rules and membership requirements. Filter by booking
type, parent facility, archived state, or a free-text name search.

**Parameters:**

- `filter[type]` (query)
- `filter[parent_id]` (query)
- `filter[status]` (query)
- `filter[query]` (query)
- `include` (query)
- `page[number]` (query)
- `page[size]` (query)
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `FacilityResource`
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `422`: 

#### POST /facilities

Create a facility
Creates a facility from name, description, and optional booking type, capacity, scheduling settings, visibility, and booking-form options. Other fields are ignored. Defaults to hidden from the public with public booking disabled and manager-only booking. API keys require facilities:write; session users require a facility manager or organization administrator role.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Request Body:**

Content-Type: `application/json`

**Responses:**

- `201`: `FacilityResource`
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `422`: 

#### GET /facilities/{facility}

Get a facility
Returns a single space or resource with its booking rules and membership
requirements. Archived facilities are returned as well as active ones.

**Parameters:**

- `facility` (path) (required)
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: `FacilityResource`
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `422`: 

### Membership Card

#### POST /membership_cards/send

Send a membership card for a user
Sends a membership card via the email on file for the user. This method allows
configuration of which card types to send.

This endpoint can also be used to create
and update user specific data that will be used to generate the card. If an email supplied
is not found, a new user will be created with the additional data supplied.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Request Body:**

Content-Type: `application/json`

**Responses:**

- `200`: 
- `401`: 
- `422`:

### Program

#### GET /parent_programs/options

List programs as slim dropdown options
A lightweight list of every program, meant for dropdowns and pickers.
Each row carries only the fields an option list needs, with no related
records (tags, registration opportunities, occurrences). Prefer this
over the full list endpoint when you only need names and ids.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `ParentProgramOptionResource`
- `401`: 

#### GET /parent_programs

List programs
Returns a paginated list of programs. Registration opportunities (sessions) are
excluded by default for performance - use `?include=programs` to include them.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `Program`
- `401`: 

#### POST /parent_programs

Create program
Create a top-level program. Requires the parent-programs:create API key scope and a Program Manager or Super Admin role. Programs default to draft; an omitted, null, or blank title defaults to New Program. Registration opportunities, schedules, and prices are not created.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Request Body:**

Content-Type: `application/json`

**Responses:**

- `200`: `ParentProgram`
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `422`: 

#### GET /parent_programs/{parent_program}

Get a program
Returns detailed information about a specific program including
all configuration fields. Use `?include=programs` to include registration
opportunities (sessions) with pricing information.

**Parameters:**

- `parent_program` (path) (required)
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: `Program`
- `401`: 

### Program Signup

#### GET /program_signups/export-config

Get the export options for this list

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: 
- `401`: 
- `403`: An error

#### GET /program_signups/export


**Parameters:**

- `email` (query)
- `filter[]` (query)
- `filter[program_id]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity ID. Supports comma-separated values.
- `filter[program[parent_program_id]]` (query) - Filter by program ID. Exports signups for all registration opportunities under this program.
- `filter[signup_status]` (query) - Signup lifecycle filter. Options: active, cancelled, cancelled:member, cancelled:admin. Defaults to active.
- `filter[timeScope]` (query) - Simple time scope filter. Options: upcoming (includes ongoing and active), past, all.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: 
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `422`: 

#### GET /program_signups

List program signups

**Parameters:**

- `filter[program_id]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity ID. Supports comma-separated values for multiple registration opportunities.
- `filter[program[parent_program_id]]` (query) - Filter by program ID. Returns signups for all registration opportunities under this program.
- `filter[user_id]` (query) - Filter by user ID. Non-managers can only filter to their own ID.
- `filter[query]` (query) - Search by registration opportunity name, user name, user email, guest name, additional member name, or guest email.
- `filter[status]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity time status. Supports multiple comma-separated values. Options: ongoing, upcoming, past.
- `filter[signup_status]` (query) - Manager-only signup lifecycle filter. Options: active, cancelled, cancelled:member, cancelled:admin. Defaults to active.
- `filter[timeScope]` (query) - Simple time scope filter. Options: upcoming (includes ongoing and active), past, all.
- `filter[event_start_date]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity event date range. Pass as array: filter[event_start_date][0]=start&filter[event_start_date][1]=end. Includes ongoing registration opportunities.
- `filter[upcoming]` (query) - Filter to signups for upcoming registration opportunities only.
- `filter[past]` (query) - Filter to signups for past registration opportunities only.
- `filter[ongoing]` (query) - Filter to signups for ongoing registration opportunities only.
- `filter[withTrashed]` (query) - Include soft-deleted signups. Defaults to excluding deleted.
- `filter[program[archived_at]]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity archived status. Pass empty string to exclude archived registration opportunities.
- `filter[program[deleted_at]]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity deleted status. Pass empty string to exclude deleted registration opportunities.
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: additionalMember, additionalMember.emergency, files, guest, program, program.parentProgram, transaction, user, user.family, user.family.emergency, formSubmissions, subscriptionSchedule.config.configurable, subscriptionSchedule.paymentsReceived, attendanceRecords.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `ProgramSignupResource`
- `401`: 

#### GET /program_signups/{program_signup}


**Parameters:**

- `program_signup` (path) (required)
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: additionalMember, additionalMember.emergency, files, guest, program, program.parentProgram, transaction, user, user.family, user.family.emergency, formSubmissions, subscriptionSchedule.config.configurable, subscriptionSchedule.paymentsReceived, attendanceRecords.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: `ProgramSignupResource`
- `401`: 
- `403`: An error

### Registration Opportunity

#### GET /programs/options

List registration opportunities as slim dropdown options
A lightweight list of every registration opportunity, meant for
dropdowns and pickers. Each row carries only the fields an option list
needs, with no related records or pricing. Prefer this over the full
list endpoint when you only need names and ids.

**Parameters:**

- `filter[parent_program_id]` (query) - Filter to registration opportunities under this program.
- `filter[archived_at]` (query) - Filter by archived status. Pass empty string to exclude archived registration opportunities.
- `filter[deleted_at]` (query) - Filter by deleted status. Pass empty string to exclude deleted registration opportunities.
- `filter[query]` (query) - Search registration opportunities by name (partial match).
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `RegistrationOpportunityOptionResource`
- `401`: 

#### GET /programs

- `filter[query]` (query) - Search registration opportunities by name (partial match).

- `filter[can_register]` (query) - Filter to only registration opportunities the authenticated user can register for.

- `filter[archived_at]` (query) - Filter by archived status. Pass empty string to exclude archived registration opportunities.
- `filter[deleted_at]` (query) - Filter by deleted status. Pass empty string to exclude deleted registration opportunities.
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: signups, parentProgram, waitlistSignups, attendanceSheets, occurrences.
- `append` (query) - Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options: audience, signup_count.
- `sort` (query) - Sort results by field. Prefix with - for descending. Options: id, registration_start_date, registration_end_date, event_start_date, event_end_date, created_at.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

### Transaction

#### GET /transactions

List transactions
Paginated, filterable, and sortable transaction ledger for reporting and
managed-API-key consumers. Every row is scoped to the current tenant.

**Parameters:**

- `filter[range]` (query) - Filter to transactions whose effective date falls between two dates. Pass as comma-separated start,end (or an array): filter[range]=2025-01-01,2025-01-31.
- `filter[starting_at]` (query) - Filter to transactions with an effective date on or after this date.
- `filter[ending_at]` (query) - Filter to transactions with an effective date on or before this date (end of day).
- `filter[type]` (query) - Filter by transaction type. Supports comma-separated values. Options: membership, program, charge, invoice, donation, booking, refund, transfer. Each option (other than refund) matches both the charge and its refund type.
- `filter[query]` (query) - Search transactions by related user/guest/account name or email, Stripe or native invoice number, or by program signup id.
- `filter[membership_type_id]` (query) - Filter to transactions for the given membership type (plan product) id.
- `filter[amount]` (query) - Filter by amount in dollars. Pass a bare value for an exact match, or prefix with lte: / gte: for a range bound.
- `filter[id]` (query) - Filter by exact transaction id. Supports comma-separated values.
- `filter[payout_id]` (query) - Filter by exact payout id.
- `filter[invoice_id]` (query) - Filter to transactions linked to the given Communal invoice id, whether the invoice was issued natively or through Stripe.
- `filter[subscription_schedule_id]` (query) - Filter by Communal payment plan (subscription schedule) id. This is not the Stripe `sub_sched_...` id.
- `filter[user_id]` (query) - Filter by exact owning user id.
- `filter[promotion_code_id]` (query) - Filter by exact promotion code id.
- `filter[tags]` (query) - Filter by tag name(s). Supports comma-separated values.
- `filter[with_product]` (query) - Filter to transactions associated with the given product (membership/plan) id. Takes a product id, not a boolean — it matches both transaction line items and invoice items for that product.
- `filter[with_parent_program]` (query) - Filter to transactions associated with the given parent program id(s), including the refunds of those charges. Takes parent program id(s), not a boolean. Supports comma-separated values.
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Only these options change the response; every other related field is always present. Options: tags (adds the `tags` field), invoice.bookings.bookableEntity or nativeInvoice.bookings.bookableEntity (populates `bookable_entity` inside `invoice.bookings`).
- `sort` (query) - Sort by effective date (falls back to created_at). Options: -created_at (descending) or created_at (ascending).
- `page[number]` (query) - Page number for pagination.
- `page[size]` (query) - Number of results per page.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `TransactionResource`
- `401`: 

#### GET /transactions/{transaction}

Get a transaction
Returns a single transaction with its related fields (for example
`invoice`, `associated_transaction` and `promotion_code`) always
present. Unlike the list endpoint, this endpoint doesn't accept
`include` or `append`, so the `tags` field is never returned here;
use `include=tags` on the list endpoint instead.

**Parameters:**

- `transaction` (path) (required)
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: `TransactionResource`
- `401`: 
- `404`:

- `401`:

#### POST /user_memberships

Assign a membership to a member
Gives an existing member a membership of the given type at no charge.
When the type has more than one active plan, `plan_id` is required.
A payment the member already made outside Communal is recorded only
when `payment_method` and `amount_paid` are supplied. Unlike
`membership_cards/send`, this never creates a member or cancels other
memberships.

Nothing is emailed unless `send_email` is true. When it is, the member
gets up to two emails: a "Membership Assigned" email naming the
membership and plan, sent right away, and about a minute later their
membership card. When the organization doesn't use membership cards,
or the type has no card, the type's membership form PDF is sent
instead, if it has one. No receipt is attached, even when a payment
is recorded. `data.emailed` echoes the `send_email` value.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Request Body:**

Content-Type: `application/json`

**Responses:**

- `200`: 
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `404`: 
- `422`: 

#### GET /user_memberships/{user_membership}

Get a user membership
Returns a single held membership with its membership type and pricing
plan.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

- `200`: `UserMembershipResource`
- `401`:

- `404`:

## MCP tools

MCP server tools (55). Each acts as the connected user inside their organization.

### list_programs

List programs. List the organization's programs (the top-level offerings members register for; each program has one or more registration opportunities / sessions beneath it).
Returns a paginated list. Registration opportunities are excluded by default — pass include="programs" to embed them.

REST: GET /parent_programs

- `include` (string) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: programs.
- `page` (object) - Pagination. Results are returned as {"data": [...]} with flat pagination keys (current_page, per_page, total, last_page).
- `page.number` (integer) - Page number, starting at 1.
- `page.size` (integer) - Results per page (default 30).

### get_program

Get program. Get one program by id, including all of its configuration fields. Pass include="programs" to embed its registration opportunities (sessions) with pricing.

REST: GET /parent_programs/{parent_program}

- `parent_program` (integer) (required) - The program id.
- `include` (string) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: programs.

### create_program

Create program. Create a top-level program with optional details and registration settings. Defaults to draft. Requires a Program Manager or Super Admin role. Returns the created program. Does not create registration opportunities, schedules, or prices.

REST: POST /parent_programs

- `title` (string) - Program name. Defaults to New Program when omitted.
- `description` (string) - Program description.
- `ongoing` (boolean) - Whether the program is ongoing. Clears event dates when true.
- `event_start_date` (string) - Event start date and time, including timezone offset.
- `event_end_date` (string) - Event end date and time, including timezone offset.
- `profile_image` (string) - Program image URL or public storage path.
- `location_name` (string) - Location name.
- `location_address` (string) - Location address.
- `location_latitude` (number) - Location latitude.
- `location_longitude` (number) - Location longitude.
- `pay_by_cash` (boolean) - Allow payment by cash.
- `collection_additional_information` (boolean) - Collect participant information. Defaults to true.
- `require_emergency_contact_information` (boolean) - Require emergency contact information.
- `waitlist_enabled` (boolean) - Enable the waitlist.
- `prompt_for_registrant` (boolean) - Prompt for registrant information.
- `unsplash_author_name` (string) - Unsplash image photographer name.
- `unsplash_author_link` (string) - Unsplash image photographer link.
- `demographic` (string) - Intended participant demographic.
- `instructor` (string) - Instructor display name.
- `force_participant_selection` (boolean) - Require participant selection. Disabled when participant information collection is false.
- `display_only` (boolean) - Display the program without registration.
- `draft` (boolean) - Whether the program is a draft. Defaults to true.
- `registration_fee` (number) - Registration fee in major currency units, for example 12.50.
- `cap_registration_fee` (boolean) - Cap the registration fee.
- `is_event` (boolean) - Treat the program as an event.
- `multiple_signups` (boolean) - Allow multiple signups.
- `is_hidden` (boolean) - Hide the program from public listings.
- `show_participant_list` (boolean) - Show the participant list.
- `hide_participant_details` (boolean) - Hide participant details.
- `total_spots` (integer) - Total program capacity.
- `allow_file_uploads` (boolean) - Allow registration file uploads.
- `file_uploads_required` (boolean) - Require registration file uploads.
- `file_uploads_max` (integer) - Maximum number of uploaded files.
- `auto_archive` (boolean) - Automatically archive the program.
- `auto_archive_days` (integer) - Days before automatic archival.
- `participant_must_hold_membership` (boolean) - Require participants to hold a membership.
- `gl_code` (string) - General ledger code.

### list_registration_opportunities

List registration opportunities. List registration opportunities (the individual sessions/occurrences of a program that members sign up for). Paginated; supports filtering, sorting and includes.

REST: GET /programs

- `filter` (object) - Filters, all optional.
- `filter.parent_program_id` (integer) - Only opportunities under this program id.
- `filter.status` (string) - Comma-separated statuses. Options: active, upcoming, past, ongoing, archived.
- `filter.query` (string) - Search by name (partial match).
- `filter.with_participants` (boolean) - Only opportunities that have participants.
- `filter.can_register` (boolean) - Only opportunities the connected user can register for.
- `filter.upcoming` (boolean) - Only upcoming opportunities.
- `filter.past` (boolean) - Only past opportunities.
- `filter.archived_at` (string) - Filter by archived status; pass an empty string to exclude archived opportunities.
- `filter.deleted_at` (string) - Filter by deleted status; pass an empty string to exclude deleted opportunities.
- `include` (string) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: signups, parentProgram, waitlistSignups, attendanceSheets, occurrences.
- `append` (string) - Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options: audience, signup_count.
- `sort` (string) - Sort field, prefix with - for descending. Options: id, registration_start_date, registration_end_date, event_start_date, event_end_date, created_at.
- `page` (object) - Pagination. Results are returned as {"data": [...]} with flat pagination keys (current_page, per_page, total, last_page).
- `page.number` (integer) - Page number, starting at 1.
- `page.size` (integer) - Results per page (default 30).

### get_registration_opportunity

Get registration opportunity. Get one registration opportunity (program session) by id.

REST: GET /programs/{program}

- `program` (integer) (required) - The registration opportunity id.
- `include` (string) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: metadata, prices, prices.membership, prices.plan, prices.schedule_config, signups, parentProgram, waitlistSignups, attendanceSheets, occurrences.
- `append` (string) - Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options: signup_count.

### create_registration_opportunity

Create registration opportunity. Create a registration opportunity under an existing program. Requires a manager role or an instructor assigned to that program. Dates and times use the organization timezone. Returns the created registration opportunity.

REST: POST /programs

- `parent_program_id` (integer) (required) - The existing parent program id.
- `name` (string) (required) - Registration opportunity name.
- `description` (string) - Registration opportunity description (plain text or simple HTML).
- `class_limit` (integer) - Maximum number of registrations.
- `ongoing` (boolean) - An ongoing opportunity has no scheduled event dates.
- `event_start_date` (string) - Event start date and time; omit when supplying occurrences.
- `event_end_date` (string) - Event end date and time; omit when supplying occurrences.
- `registration_start_date` (string) - Registration opening date and time.
- `registration_end_date` (string) - Registration closing date and time.
- `registration_open_until_event_start` (boolean) - Keep registration open until the event starts, ignoring registration_end_date.
- `occurrences` (array of objects) - Scheduled occurrences; omit for ongoing opportunities.
- `occurrences[].starts_at` (string) - Occurrence start date and time.
- `occurrences[].ends_at` (string) - Occurrence end date and time.
- `prices` (array of objects) - Prices by audience. Omit for a free opportunity open to everyone.
- `prices[].price` (integer) - Price in cents.
- `prices[].free` (boolean) - true when this audience registers at no charge.
- `prices[].guest_price` (boolean) - true for the price that applies to people without a qualifying membership.
- `prices[].volunteer_price` (boolean) - true for the price that applies to people signed up to volunteer for this program.
- `prices[].membership_id` (string) - Limit this price to holders of a membership type, by its product_id.
- `prices[].plan_id` (string) - Limit this price to holders of one membership plan, by the plan ID listed in the membership type's plans.
- `prices[].maximum_number_of_purchases` (integer) - Maximum registrations one person can buy at this price.
- `prices[].recurring` (boolean) - Split the price into scheduled payments instead of one payment at checkout.
- `waitlist_enabled` (boolean) - Let people join a waitlist when all spots are taken.
- `display_to_all_users` (boolean) - Legacy visibility flag; no longer affects what members see.
- `hide_from_non_buyers` (boolean) - Hide this opportunity from people who have no price that applies to them.
- `exclude_from_reminder_emails` (boolean) - Do not send reminder emails to registrants.
- `dob_validation` (boolean) - Require participants to be born between min_date_of_birth and max_date_of_birth.
- `min_date_of_birth` (string) - Oldest allowed participant date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `max_date_of_birth` (string) - Youngest allowed participant date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `allow_file_uploads` (boolean) - Collect files from registrants at signup.
- `file_uploads_required` (boolean) - Make the file upload mandatory at signup.
- `file_uploads_max` (integer) - Maximum number of files per signup.

### list_program_signups

List program signups. List program signups (registrations of members/guests to registration opportunities). Paginated. Non-managers only see their own signups.

REST: GET /program_signups

- `filter` (object) - Filters, all optional.
- `filter.program_id` (string) - Registration opportunity id(s), comma-separated.
- `filter.user_id` (integer) - Only signups for this user id (non-managers may only use their own id).
- `filter.query` (string) - Search by opportunity name, user name/email, guest name/email or additional member name.
- `filter.status` (string) - Opportunity time status, comma-separated. Options: ongoing, upcoming, past.
- `filter.signup_status` (string) - Manager-only lifecycle filter. Options: active, cancelled, cancelled:member, cancelled:admin. Defaults to active.
- `filter.timeScope` (`upcoming`, `past`, `all`) - Simple time scope; upcoming includes ongoing.
- `filter.upcoming` (boolean) - Only signups for upcoming opportunities.
- `filter.past` (boolean) - Only signups for past opportunities.
- `filter.ongoing` (boolean) - Only signups for ongoing opportunities.
- `filter.withTrashed` (boolean) - Include soft-deleted signups.
- `include` (string) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: additionalMember, files, guest, program, program.parentProgram, transaction, user, user.family, formSubmissions.
- `page` (object) - Pagination. Results are returned as {"data": [...]} with flat pagination keys (current_page, per_page, total, last_page).
- `page.number` (integer) - Page number, starting at 1.
- `page.size` (integer) - Results per page (default 30).

### get_program_signup

Get program signup. Get one program signup by id.

REST: GET /program_signups/{program_signup}

- `program_signup` (integer) (required) - The program signup id.
- `include` (string) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: additionalMember, files, guest, program, program.parentProgram, transaction, user, user.family, formSubmissions.

### export_program_signups

Export program signups as CSV. Export program signups to a CSV file. Accepts the same filters as list_program_signups. Small exports return a temporary download_url (valid ~10 minutes) plus record_count; larger exports are prepared in the background and emailed to the caller, in which case immediate is false and there is no download_url. Requires a manager role; instructors always receive their program-scoped export by email. Share the download_url with the user — do not try to fetch the CSV yourself.

REST: GET /program_signups/export

- `filter` (object) - Filters, all optional — same semantics as list_program_signups.
- `filter.program_id` (string) - Registration opportunity id(s), comma-separated.
- `filter.program.parent_program_id` (integer) - Program id — exports signups across all of its registration opportunities.
- `filter.signup_status` (string) - Lifecycle filter. Options: active, cancelled, cancelled:member, cancelled:admin. Defaults to active.
- `filter.timeScope` (`upcoming`, `past`, `all`) - Simple time scope; upcoming includes ongoing.
- `filter.withTrashed` (boolean) - Include soft-deleted signups.

### update_program

Update a program. Change a program's details — title, description, dates, location, price, spots, tags, or whether it's published, hidden or has a waitlist. Only send what you want to change; everything else stays exactly as it is. Refer to the program by name or ID. Runs as a preview first; call again with mode "apply" to save.

- `program` (string) (required) - The program to change: its name (e.g. "Youth Basketball") or ID.
- `title` (string) - New title.
- `description` (string) - New description (plain text or simple HTML).
- `starts_on` (string) - First day of the program, YYYY-MM-DD, in the organization’s timezone.
- `ends_on` (string) - Last day of the program, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `ongoing` (boolean) - true if the program runs with no fixed dates. Setting this clears the start and end dates.
- `location_name` (string) - Where it happens, e.g. "Main Gym".
- `location_address` (string) - Street address of the location.
- `registration_fee` (string) - One-time registration fee in dollars, e.g. "25.00". Use "0" for no fee.
- `total_spots` (integer) - Maximum people across all sessions. Send 0 to remove the limit.
- `published` (boolean) - true to publish the program so members can see it; false to move it back to draft.
- `hidden` (boolean) - true to hide the program from member-facing lists (still reachable by direct link).
- `waitlist` (boolean) - true to let people join a waitlist when the program is full.
- `tags` (array of strings) - The complete list of tags the program should have (replaces the current tags).
- `mode` (`preview`, `apply`) - "preview" (default) checks the change and shows exactly what would happen without saving anything. "apply" makes the change.

### clone_program

Copy a program. Make a copy of a program — for example to run last season's program again. The copy starts as a draft called "<title> (Copy)", keeps the waivers, facilities and tax settings, and by default copies every session and its prices too. Optionally move all dates forward one year. Refer to the program by name or ID. Runs as a preview first; call again with mode "apply" to create the copy, then use update_program to rename or publish it.

- `program` (string) (required) - The program to copy: its name or ID.
- `include_sessions` (boolean) - Copy the program’s sessions and their prices too (default true).
- `move_dates_forward_one_year` (boolean) - Shift the program and session dates forward by exactly one year (default false).
- `mode` (`preview`, `apply`) - "preview" (default) checks the change and shows exactly what would happen without saving anything. "apply" makes the change.

### add_session

Add a session. Add a session (registration opportunity) to an existing program — for example "Spring 2027, Tuesdays 6–7pm, 12 spots, $40". Give a single date (starts_at/ends_at), a weekly schedule, or ongoing; spots; when sign-up opens and closes (or keep it open until the session starts, the default); and what non-members and specific membership types pay. Refer to the program by name or ID. Runs as a preview first; call again with mode "apply" to create it.

REST: POST /programs

- `program` (string) (required) - The program to add the session to: its name or ID.
- `name` (string) (required) - Name of the new session, e.g. "Spring 2027 — Tuesdays".
- `description` (string) - Description (plain text or simple HTML).
- `spots` (integer) - How many people can sign up for this session.
- `no_spot_limit` (boolean) - true to remove this session’s own limit (the program’s overall limit, if any, still applies).
- `ongoing` (boolean) - true if the session runs with no fixed dates. Clears any dates.
- `starts_at` (string) - For a single date: when it starts, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" in the organization’s timezone.
- `ends_at` (string) - For a single date: when it ends, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM".
- `weekly` (object) - A repeating weekly schedule. Replaces any existing dates.
- `weekly.days` (array of strings) - Days of the week, e.g. ["tuesday", "thursday"].
- `weekly.start_time` (string) - Start time each day, "HH:MM" (24-hour).
- `weekly.end_time` (string) - End time each day, "HH:MM" (24-hour).
- `weekly.first_date` (string) - First date the schedule can start, "YYYY-MM-DD".
- `weekly.last_date` (string) - Last date, "YYYY-MM-DD". Give this or number_of_dates.
- `weekly.number_of_dates` (integer) - How many weeks’ worth of dates to generate. Give this or last_date. Skipped dates are taken out of this total.
- `weekly.skip_dates` (array of strings) - Dates to skip, "YYYY-MM-DD" (holidays etc.).
- `registration_opens` (string) - When sign-up opens, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM".
- `registration_closes` (string) - When sign-up closes, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM".
- `registration_open_until_start` (boolean) - true to keep sign-up open right up until the session starts, instead of fixed opening and closing dates.
- `waitlist` (boolean) - true to let people join a waitlist when the session is full.
- `non_member_price` (string) - What people without a membership pay, in dollars, e.g. "40.00". Use "0" for free, or "none" to stop non-members signing up.
- `member_prices` (array of objects) - Prices for specific membership types. Only the types listed change.
- `member_prices[].membership_type` (string) - Membership type name or ID.
- `member_prices[].price` (string) - Dollars, "0" for free, or "none" to stop this membership signing up.
- `mode` (`preview`, `apply`) - "preview" (default) checks the change and shows exactly what would happen without saving anything. "apply" makes the change.

### update_session

Update a session. Change one session (registration opportunity) of a program — its name, spots, dates or weekly schedule, sign-up window, waitlist, or prices for non-members and specific membership types. Only send what you want to change; prices, dates and everything else stay exactly as they are. Refer to the session by name or ID, and pass the program too when the session name is used by more than one program. Runs as a preview first; call again with mode "apply" to save.

- `session` (string) (required) - The session to change: its name (e.g. "Spring 2027 — Tuesdays") or ID.
- `program` (string) - The program the session belongs to (name or ID), to tell apart sessions with the same name.
- `name` (string) - Name of the session, e.g. "Spring 2027 — Tuesdays".
- `description` (string) - Description (plain text or simple HTML).
- `spots` (integer) - How many people can sign up for this session.
- `no_spot_limit` (boolean) - true to remove this session’s own limit (the program’s overall limit, if any, still applies).
- `ongoing` (boolean) - true if the session runs with no fixed dates. Clears any dates.
- `starts_at` (string) - For a single date: when it starts, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" in the organization’s timezone.
- `ends_at` (string) - For a single date: when it ends, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM".
- `weekly` (object) - A repeating weekly schedule. Replaces any existing dates.
- `weekly.days` (array of strings) - Days of the week, e.g. ["tuesday", "thursday"].
- `weekly.start_time` (string) - Start time each day, "HH:MM" (24-hour).
- `weekly.end_time` (string) - End time each day, "HH:MM" (24-hour).
- `weekly.first_date` (string) - First date the schedule can start, "YYYY-MM-DD".
- `weekly.last_date` (string) - Last date, "YYYY-MM-DD". Give this or number_of_dates.
- `weekly.number_of_dates` (integer) - How many weeks’ worth of dates to generate. Give this or last_date. Skipped dates are taken out of this total.
- `weekly.skip_dates` (array of strings) - Dates to skip, "YYYY-MM-DD" (holidays etc.).
- `registration_opens` (string) - When sign-up opens, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM".
- `registration_closes` (string) - When sign-up closes, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM".
- `registration_open_until_start` (boolean) - true to keep sign-up open right up until the session starts, instead of fixed opening and closing dates.
- `waitlist` (boolean) - true to let people join a waitlist when the session is full.
- `non_member_price` (string) - What people without a membership pay, in dollars, e.g. "40.00". Use "0" for free, or "none" to stop non-members signing up.
- `member_prices` (array of objects) - Prices for specific membership types. Only the types listed change.
- `member_prices[].membership_type` (string) - Membership type name or ID.
- `member_prices[].price` (string) - Dollars, "0" for free, or "none" to stop this membership signing up.
- `mode` (`preview`, `apply`) - "preview" (default) checks the change and shows exactly what would happen without saving anything. "apply" makes the change.

### list_attendance_sheets

REST: GET /attendance_sheets

- `filter` (object) - Filters, all optional.
- `filter.registration_opportunity_id` (integer) - Only sheets for this registration opportunity id.
- `filter.parent_program_id` (integer) - Only sheets under this program id.
- `filter.date` (string) - Only sheets on this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `include` (string) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: registrationOpportunities, records, records.programSignup.
- `page` (object) - Pagination. Results are returned as {"data": [...]} with flat pagination keys (current_page, per_page, total, last_page).
- `page.number` (integer) - Page number, starting at 1.
- `page.size` (integer) - Results per page (default 30).

### list_attendance_records

REST: GET /attendance_records/{attendance_record}

### mark_attendance_record

Mark attendance. Update an existing attendance record for a program signup on a specific sheet. Accepts status, notes, marked_at (timestamp with timezone), and marked_by (user ID). Timestamp and marker default to now and the credential owner. Requires the owning staff user to be a manager or an instructor assigned to the signup program.

REST: PUT /attendance_records/{attendance_record}/mark

- `attendance_record` (integer) (required) - The attendance record ID; records are specific to a sheet and signup.
- `status` (`absent`, `excused`, `excluded`, `late`, `present`, `unmarked`) (required) - Attendance status to record.
- `notes` (string) - Free-text note about this attendance mark.
- `marked_at` (string) - When attendance was marked, with timezone, e.g. 2026-09-09T15:00:00Z. Defaults to now.
- `marked_by` (integer) - ID of the user who marked attendance, within this tenant. Defaults to the credential owner.

### register_attendance

Register and mark attendance. Create a program signup and mark attendance for a person not previously registered. Use existing_user with user_id for a member, or walk_in with name for a guest. program_id must be a registration opportunity on the attendance sheet. Creates a new signup on each call. Requires the owning staff user to have the existing attendance registration permission: program manager, super admin, or assigned instructor. Returns the attendance record. Timestamp and marker default to now and the credential owner.

REST: POST /attendance_sheets/{attendance_sheet}/mark

- `attendance_sheet` (integer) (required) - The attendance sheet ID.
- `program_id` (integer) (required) - A registration opportunity ID included on the sheet.
- `participant_type` (`existing_user`, `walk_in`) (required) - existing_user for a member of the organization, walk_in for a guest.
- `user_id` (integer) - Required for existing_user.
- `additional_member_id` (integer) - An existing family member belonging to user_id.
- `name` (string) - Required for walk_in.
- `email` (string) - Walk-in guest email.
- `telephone` (string) - Walk-in guest phone number.
- `date_of_birth` (string) - Walk-in guest date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `amount_paid` (number) - Amount collected, in the organization's currency (e.g. 25.00).
- `payment_method` (string) - How the amount was paid, e.g. cash.
- `trigger_assign_email` (boolean) - Send the assignment email; defaults to false.
- `attach_invoice` (boolean) - Attach an invoice to the assignment email; defaults to false.
- `additional_member` (object) - Optional family member to create for a walk-in guest.
- `additional_member.name` (string) - Family member name.
- `additional_member.email` (string) - Family member email.
- `additional_member.date_of_birth` (string) - Family member date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `additional_member.emergency_contact_name` (string) - Emergency contact name.
- `additional_member.emergency_contact_phone` (string) - Emergency contact phone number.
- `additional_member.gender` (string) - Family member gender.
- `additional_member.medical` (string) - Medical notes for the family member.
- `status` (`absent`, `excused`, `excluded`, `late`, `present`, `unmarked`) (required) - Attendance status to record.
- `notes` (string) - Free-text note about this attendance mark.
- `marked_at` (string) - When attendance was marked, with timezone, e.g. 2026-09-09T15:00:00Z. Defaults to now.
- `marked_by` (integer) - ID of the user who marked attendance, within this tenant. Defaults to the credential owner.

### mark_attendance

Mark attendance. Mark one or more people present, absent, late, excused or excluded for one date of a session — for example "mark Sam Broadbent and Lena Kowalczyk present at the Competitive Team session on 2026-09-24". Refer to the session and the people by name or ID; no lookups needed. The people must already be on that date's attendance sheet. Runs as a preview first and shows each person's current and new mark; call again with mode "apply" to save.

REST: PUT /attendance_records/{attendance_record}/mark

- `session` (string) (required) - The session people signed up for: its name (e.g. "Competitive Team") or ID.
- `program` (string) - The program the session belongs to, by name or ID. Only needed when more than one session has the same name.
- `date` (string) (required) - The day of the session, YYYY-MM-DD, in the organization’s timezone (e.g. "2026-09-24").
- `people` (array of strings) (required) - Who to mark: each entry is a full name, an email address or a person’s ID, e.g. ["Sam Broadbent", "Lena Kowalczyk"].
- `status` (`present`, `late`, `absent`, `excused`, `excluded`, `unmarked`) (required) - "present" = came; "late" = came but arrived late; "absent" = didn’t come; "excused" = missed it for an accepted reason; "excluded" = not expected that day, so it doesn’t count either way; "unmarked" = clear the mark.
- `notes` (string) - Optional note saved on each person’s mark, e.g. "Called ahead". Leave out to keep existing notes.
- `mode` (`preview`, `apply`) - "preview" (default) checks the change and shows exactly what would happen without saving anything. "apply" makes the change.

### get_user

REST: GET /users/{user}

- `user` (integer) (required) - The user id.
- `include` (string) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: card, family, roles, permissions, files.

### update_user

Update user. Update a user's (member's) profile. This is a full update like the REST API's PUT: first_name, last_name and email are always required — read the user first (get_user) and resend the current values for anything you are not changing. Returns the updated user. Non-managers can only update themselves and their family.

REST: PUT /users/{user}

- `user` (integer) (required) - The user id.
- `first_name` (string) (required) - First name.
- `last_name` (string) (required) - Last name.
- `email` (string) (required) - Email address (must be unique within the organization).
- `middle_name` (string) - Middle name.
- `preferred_name` (string) - Preferred name.
- `name` (string) - Full display name.
- `date_of_birth` (string) - Date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `telephone` (string) - Phone number.
- `profile_address` (string) - Street address.
- `profile_address_line_2` (string) - Address line 2.
- `profile_city` (string) - City.
- `profile_state` (string) - Province or state.
- `profile_zip` (string) - Postal or ZIP code.
- `profile_country` (string) - ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

### create_user

- `user_editable` (boolean) - Whether members may edit the value themselves.
- `applies_to_users` (boolean) - Whether this field applies to user profiles. Defaults to true. At least one of applies_to_users or applies_to_family_members must be true.

### update_member

Update a person. Change a person's details — name, email, phone, date of birth, address, or custom profile fields such as "Jersey Size". Only send what you want to change; everything else stays exactly as it is. Refer to the person by name, email or ID, and to profile fields by their name. Runs as a preview first; call again with mode "apply" to save.

REST: PUT /users/{user}, POST /custom_profile_field_values, PUT /custom_profile_field_values/{id}

- `person` (string) (required) - The person to change: their full name (e.g. "Maya Chen"), email or ID.
- `first_name` (string) - New first name.
- `last_name` (string) - New last name.
- `email` (string) - New email address. It must not belong to anyone else in the organization.
- `date_of_birth` (string) - Date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD. Send an empty string to clear it.
- `preferred_name` (string) - The name they like to go by, if different from their first name.
- `phone` (string) - Phone number, e.g. "403-555-0100".
- `address` (string) - Street address.
- `address_line_2` (string) - Apartment, suite or unit.
- `city` (string) - City.
- `state` (string) - Province or state.
- `postal_code` (string) - Postal or ZIP code.
- `country` (string) - Two-letter country code, e.g. "CA" or "US".
- `profile_fields` (object) - Custom profile fields by their name, e.g. {"Jersey Size": "M"}. Send an empty string to clear a field.
- `mode` (`preview`, `apply`) - "preview" (default) checks the change and shows exactly what would happen without saving anything. "apply" makes the change.

### add_member

Add a person. Add a new person to the organization with their name and email, plus optional phone, address and custom profile fields such as "Jersey Size" (by field name). They get a welcome email as soon as they are added. Warns when someone with the same email or name already exists. Runs as a preview first; call again with mode "apply" to add them. To set a date of birth, use update_member afterwards.

- `first_name` (string) (required) - First name.
- `last_name` (string) (required) - Last name.
- `email` (string) (required) - Email address. Each person in the organization needs their own.
- `preferred_name` (string) - The name they like to go by, if different from their first name.
- `phone` (string) - Phone number, e.g. "403-555-0100".
- `address` (string) - Street address.
- `address_line_2` (string) - Apartment, suite or unit.
- `city` (string) - City.
- `state` (string) - Province or state.
- `postal_code` (string) - Postal or ZIP code.
- `country` (string) - Two-letter country code, e.g. "CA" or "US".
- `profile_fields` (object) - Custom profile fields by their name, e.g. {"Jersey Size": "M"}. Send an empty string to clear a field.
- `mode` (`preview`, `apply`) - "preview" (default) checks the change and shows exactly what would happen without saving anything. "apply" makes the change.

### list_user_memberships

List user memberships. List the memberships members hold — which membership type and plan each member is on, its status (active/expired/retrying), expiry date and auto-renewal state. Paginated.

REST: GET /user_memberships

- `filter` (object) - Filters, all optional.

- `filter.active` (boolean) - Only memberships that have not expired.
- `filter.expired` (boolean) - Only memberships that have expired.
- `filter.expires_starting_at` (string) - Only memberships ending on or after this ISO 8601 date/datetime.
- `filter.expires_ending_at` (string) - Only memberships ending on or before this ISO 8601 date/datetime.
- `page` (object) - Pagination. Results are returned as {"data": [...]} with flat pagination keys (current_page, per_page, total, last_page).
- `page.number` (integer) - Page number, starting at 1.
